question_en: Movies and TV series set in Naples
question_fr: Films et séries télévisées se déroulant à Naples
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql:
SELECT U.ID_CONTENT, U.CONTENT_TYPE
  FROM (
        (SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'movie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED AS SORT_KEY
           FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION
          WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_NAME = 'Naples'
           AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0
           AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative'
           AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.DELETED = 0
           AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IS_MOVIE = 1
          ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC
          LIMIT 10)
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'serie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED AS SORT_KEY
           FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.ID_SERIE = T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION
          WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_NAME = 'Naples'
           AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0
           AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative'
           AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.DELETED = 0
           AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE.DELETED = 0
          ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC
          LIMIT 10)
       ) AS U
 ORDER BY U.SORT_KEY DESC
 LIMIT 20
